FN-KD415AA-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 72
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Ritchie Whorton
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 02/10/2025
House Bill 72 as introduced would increase the annual additional fee for the volunteer and
professional firefighter and retired firefighter distinctive vehicle license plates from $1, under
current law, to $11. This bill would also levy an additional $10 fee.
This bill would also provide for the distribution of these funds as shown below, which would
increase estimated receipts to the entities listed :
